hook: America votes: who will control Congress?
reel_hook: America votes today. Here's what's at stake.

slides.title: Congress up for grabs
slides.image_prompt: Rows of empty voting booths beside a ballot box filled with red and blue ballots, soft morning light through tall windows.
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Americans vote today for all 435 House seats.
WHY IT MATTERS
Results decide Congress for Trump's last two years.
FOR YOU
Polls suggest Democrats lead; Trump predicts Republicans keep both chambers.
slides.body: Americans vote today for all 435 House seats. Results decide Congress for Trump's last two years. Polls suggest Democrats lead; Trump predicts Republicans keep both chambers.

slides.title: US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island
slides.image_prompt: A rocky island in a deep blue strait seen from above, with a naval chart and brass compass laid over the scene.
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The US hit Qeshm Island in limited 'defensive' strikes.
WHY IT MATTERS
Iran says a deal remains far off despite talks.
FOR YOU
US officials say it's not a return to major combat; Qatar is mediating talks.
slides.body: The US hit Qeshm Island in limited 'defensive' strikes. Iran says a deal remains far off despite talks. US officials say it's not a return to major combat; Qatar is mediating talks.

slides.title: Huge overnight attack on Ukraine
slides.image_prompt: A darkened city skyline at night under silent power lines, one small candle glowing in a single window.
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Zelensky says Russia fired 289 drones overnight, plus missiles.
WHY IT MATTERS
The attack hit nine regions, causing emergency power cuts.
FOR YOU
Separately, a strike on an aid site killed at least 31, officials said Tuesday.
slides.body: Zelensky says Russia fired 289 drones overnight, plus missiles. The attack hit nine regions, causing emergency power cuts. Separately, a strike on an aid site killed at least 31, officials said Tuesday.

slides.title: North Korea denies Binance hack
slides.image_prompt: A cracked steel vault door on a dark desk with golden crypto coins spilling out across the floor.
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Kim Yo Jong rejected FBI claims Pyongyang stole $6.3bn.
WHY IT MATTERS
It's the biggest crypto theft on record.
FOR YOU
Binance users: the exchange says it covered 90% of losses itself.
slides.body: Kim Yo Jong rejected FBI claims Pyongyang stole $6.3bn. It's the biggest crypto theft on record. Binance users: the exchange says it covered 90% of losses itself.

slides.title: Ocarina of Time returns
slides.image_prompt: A blue ocarina resting on mossy stones in a sunlit forest clearing, soft fantasy glow and floating dust in the light.
slides.label: CULTURE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Nintendo's 1998 Zelda classic is remade for Switch 2.
WHY IT MATTERS
NPR's review says it lasts 'for generations to come.'
FOR YOU
Switch 2 owners: check Nintendo's site for your local release date.
slides.body: Nintendo's 1998 Zelda classic is remade for Switch 2. NPR's review says it lasts 'for generations to come.' Switch 2 owners: check Nintendo's site for your local release date.

caption:
🗳️ US midterms today: all 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats and 36 governors on the ballot. Polls suggest Democrats lead; Trump predicts Republicans hold.
💥 US carries out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island; Iran says a deal is still far off.
⚡ Ukraine says Russia fired 289 drones overnight; an aid-site strike killed at least 31, officials said Tuesday.
💻 North Korea rejects FBI claims it stole $6.3bn from Binance. Binance users: the exchange says it covered 90% of losses.
🎮 Zelda: Ocarina of Time is back, remade for Switch 2.
